# Main Street

> Main Street is an open-source toolkit for building a professional small-business website for about $12 a year. The business owner updates the site by chatting with any AI assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar): the AI prepares every change as its own pull request with a preview link, the owner reviews it on their phone, and says "ship it" to make it live. No page builder, no monthly fees, no developer on retainer.

## What it is

- A **site template** (`template/`): a fast, accessible small-business website with a setup wizard, business-type presets, and plain-English guides.
- A **scaffolder** (`scripts/new-site.mjs`): turns the template into a new customer site repo in one command.
- An **AI knowledge base** (`template/rules/`, `template/features/`, `template/presets/`, `template/AGENTS.md`, the single manual every AI reads): instructions so any AI assistant can safely maintain the site.
- **Docs**: [the $12/year stack](docs/the-12-dollar-stack.md), [setup guide](template/docs/setup-guide.md), [connect your AI](template/docs/connect-your-ai.md), [API keys](template/docs/api-keys.md), [everyday examples](template/docs/examples.md), [owner page](template/README.md), [for agencies](docs/for-agencies.md).

## Who it is for

Small business owners (plumbers, salons, bakeries, restaurants, shops) who want a professional website without learning a page builder or paying monthly fees, who can set everything up themselves with their own AI in about an hour. A helper (agency, freelancer, or tech-savvy friend) is optional.

## How updates work (the golden loop)

1. The owner tells their AI assistant what they want, in plain words.
2. The AI prepares the change on its own branch and pull request, and sends the **preview link** Cloudflare builds for it.
3. The owner opens the preview link on their phone and checks it.
4. The owner says **"ship it"** and the live site updates in about a minute.

Nothing goes live without the owner seeing and approving it first.

## Key vocabulary

- **Preview link**: every change gets its own, built by Cloudflare from its pull request. There is no shared staging site. The live site is locked: GitHub blocks direct changes to `main`.
- **Ship it**: the owner's approval phrase. It means merge that pull request to production. **Undo that** means the AI prepares a revert as a new preview.
- **The $12/year stack**: the cost model. About $12 a year for the domain name; hosting, CDN, contact form email, and analytics run on free tiers (Cloudflare Workers static assets, Cloudflare Email Routing, Cloudflare Web Analytics). The hands-free AI loop needs a paid AI plan (about $20/month, Claude Pro or ChatGPT Plus).
- **Graceful degradation**: until the contact form's email is set up, the feature quietly steps back (visitors see an email address instead of a form) and the page never breaks.

## Technical facts

- Static site built with Vite; plain HTML/CSS, no framework.
- Runs on Cloudflare Workers with static assets, built by Workers Builds: `main` is production, every other branch gets its own preview link. A Deploy to Cloudflare button creates the owner's repository and live site in one step. The repository is public, with a GitHub ruleset on `main` that requires a pull request.
- Contact form is a tiny Worker that emails the owner through Cloudflare Email Routing's `send_email` binding: no API key, no third-party account.
- MIT licensed. Repository: https://github.com/davegelinas/main-street
